verdict.rationale: Omnara has no documented region or residency selector for its hosted service. However, it is free to self-host under Apache 2.0, and self-hosted deployments keep agent history in your own Postgres. That lets a user control where data lives only by running the stack themselves. Missing for 10: hosted region/residency selection, documented data-residency guarantees or policy, and independent corroboration of self-hosted data locality.
